body:
# Google Analytics

Analytics optimization improved targeting, reporting, and UX—boosting signup conversions by 45% and raising Google Analytics maturity from 2 to 4.5.

Though the client ran various campaigns on marketing channels, discovering which tactics worked and which didn’t work seemed difficult. Identifying the right marketing mix was also difficult for them without proper Google Analytics reports. Identifying right audience and understanding the factors that determined goal conversion was difficult.

### Our Approach

Audited tracking, then rebuilt measurement to capture accurate events, funnels, and signals.

Used AI-driven behavior insights to surface drop-offs, intent segments, and friction points.

Ran A/B experiments and UX refinements to lift conversions and reduce abandonment.

Implemented ongoing monitoring so teams continuously learn, iterate, and improve performance.

Our web analytics experts followed a strategic approach to meet the client’s objectives. Initially, we had developed an assessment framework for measuring Google Analytics implementation maturity. The framework has five main components including Business Objectives, Google Analytics Utilization, Customer Acquisition, Customer Engagement, Campaign Management and Reporting. This framework helped to score each component from 1 to 5. For example, the component Google Analytics Utilization has a score of 1 if GA is not utilized, score of 2 if default configuration setup, score of 3 if custom configuration setup, score of 5 if GA was used as a strategic tool, etc
